purpose: Hand-constructed teaching and method-design case; never an independent performance sample.
prefix_generation: A prescribed legal public setup independent of the hidden world; endgame policies apply only after this prefix.

opponent_policies_after_prefix.3: ideal uniform distribution over current legal actions

belief_assumptions: Only P1 has two possible ticket assignments in this artificial belief. P3's private NB ticket has point-mass belief; it is not publicly revealed by game rules. Do not condition the focal decision on the actual hidden world.
utility: Final victory share: score then completed-ticket tiebreak, then 1/k for joint winners.
cutoff: Counterfactual settlement of current ownership in each hypothetical world, averaged over belief; never mark a live game finished.
depth: h counts opponent actions after the root action: 0, 1, 2, 3; all games finish at h=3.
root_actions: All legal actions, sorted by (kind, route_id or empty); maximize belief-averaged value before applying this deterministic tie order.
reference: Enumerate every world and every legal P3 action with fractions.Fraction; no sampling or RNG seeds.
